children: U.S. regional bank's Q3 net income rose 20% yr/yr, with EPS up to $1.90
Company cites net interest income growth and margin improvement as key drivers
Allowance for credit losses increased due to one commercial loan, but net charge-offs stayed low
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or full year in the press release
NET INTEREST INCOME - Net interest income rose 15% yr/yr, driven by higher loan volumes and improved yields
NONINTEREST INCOME - Noninterest income increased 13%, mainly from higher gains on loan sales, debit card fees, service charges, and bank owned life insurance earnings
EXPENSE GROWTH - Noninterest expense rose 9% due to investments in personnel, technology, and operational infrastructure
